goal.en: Buy bread for the week and a treat or two.
goal.zh: 買一週份的麵包，再挑一兩樣點心。

background: cozy neighborhood bakery with wooden shelves of fresh bread loaves, a glass display case of croissants and pies, warm hanging lamps, plain flour sacks in the corner, early morning

intro.en: Mia told you about a bakery that smells like heaven. At eight a.m., you follow your nose there.
intro.zh: 米亞跟你說過，有一家麵包店香得不得了。早上八點，你循著香味找了過去。

intro.en: Warm bread fills the shelves, and a cheerful baker waves from behind the counter.
intro.zh: 架上擺滿熱騰騰的麵包，一位開朗的麵包師傅在櫃檯後向你揮手。

lines.en: Good morning! Everything's fresh out of the oven. What can I get you?
lines.zh: 早安！全部都是剛出爐的。要買什麼呢？

choices.en: A loaf of white bread, please.
choices.tip: a loaf of bread 是「一條麵包」，買整條吐司或麵包都這樣說。

lines.en: Toast? Sure, I can toast a slice for you. Butter?
lines.zh: 烤吐司？好啊，我幫你烤一片。要加奶油嗎？

story.en: Five minutes later, you're holding one warm slice of buttered toast. Delicious, but it won't last the week.
story.zh: 五分鐘後，你手裡拿著一片熱騰騰的奶油烤吐司。很好吃，但撐不過一個星期。

fail.why: 台灣說的「吐司」，英文是 bread 或 sliced bread，toast 是「烤過的麵包片」。要買一整條就說 A loaf of white bread, please.。

lines.en: Quick? Well, good bread takes time, you know.
lines.zh: 快點？好麵包是需要時間的。

story.en: She serves you in polite silence. Every other customer gets a free cookie and a smile. You get a receipt.
story.zh: 她客氣但沉默地幫你結帳。其他客人都拿到一塊免費小餅乾和一個笑容，你只拿到一張收據。

fail.why: Give me... 再加上 Quick. 聽起來像在命令店員。點餐用「東西 + please」或 I'll have... 就好，例如 A loaf of white bread, please.。

lines.en: One loaf. Anything else? The croissants just came out.
lines.zh: 一條吐司。還要別的嗎？可頌剛出爐喔。

choices.en: Yes, can I get two of those?
choices.zh: 要，可以給我那個兩個嗎？
choices.tip: 叫不出名字也沒關係，指著說 two of those（那個兩個）就能點。

lines.en: A croissant? Or two? Sorry, it's a bit noisy in here.
lines.zh: 一個可頌？還是兩個？抱歉，這裡有點吵。

story.en: You nod at the wrong moment. You walk home with one croissant, and Mia gets the bigger half.
story.zh: 你在錯的時間點了頭，最後只帶了一個可頌回家，米亞還分走了比較大的那一半。

fail.why: two 後面的名詞要加複數 s：two croissants，少了 s 很容易聽錯。更簡單的方法是指著說 Can I get two of those?。

choices.en: Sure, let me grab them myself.

lines.en: Oh! Please don't reach in there. I'll get them for you.
lines.zh: 喔！請不要把手伸進去，我來幫你拿。

story.en: Everyone in line watches you pull your hand back from the display case. You get your croissants, plus a short talk about food hygiene.
story.zh: 排隊的人都看著你把手從展示櫃裡縮回來。你拿到了可頌，外加一段食品衛生小講座。

fail.why: 台灣很多麵包店是自己拿托盤和夾子，但櫃檯式麵包店要由店員幫你拿。指著想要的說 Can I get two of those? 就好。

lines.en: Two croissants. Oh, have you tried our apple pie?
lines.zh: 兩個可頌。對了，你吃過我們的蘋果派嗎？

lines.en: It comes in small or large. Which would you like?
lines.zh: 有小的和大的，你要哪一種？

choices.en: I'll take a small one, thanks.
choices.tip: I'll take... 是決定要買時最自然的說法，one 可以代替剛才提到的東西。

choices.en: Yes, please! I love apple pie.

lines.zh: 太好了！所以……小的還是大的？

story.en: You say yes again. She boxes up the large one, big enough for ten people. Mia is thrilled. Your wallet is not.
story.zh: 你又說了一次 yes，她就包了一個十人份的大蘋果派。米亞樂壞了，你的錢包可沒有。

fail.why: Which would you like? 是要你二選一，不能只回答 Yes。直接說出選擇：I'll take a small one.。

choices.en: Any size is fine. I don't care.
choices.zh: 什麼尺寸都行，我無所謂。

lines.en: Oh. Well, I care about my pies.
lines.zh: 喔。可是我很在乎我的派。

story.en: She hands you a small pie in silence. You're pretty sure she won't save you a croissant tomorrow.
story.zh: 她默默遞給你一個小派。你很確定，明天她不會幫你留可頌了。

fail.why: 中文想說「都可以」，直譯成 I don't care. 卻像「我才不在乎」。想表達隨意就說 Either one is fine.，或直接選：I'll take a small one.。

lines.en: Here you go, all still warm. Come back anytime!
lines.zh: 給你，都還熱熱的。歡迎再來！

lines.en: You carry the warm bag home. Mia is going to be very, very happy.
lines.zh: 你提著溫熱的紙袋回家。米亞一定會開心得不得了。

story.en: Bread for the week, croissants for breakfast and a little apple pie for dessert. Not bad for one trip!
story.zh: 一週份的麵包、早餐的可頌，再加一個飯後小蘋果派。這趟出門收穫滿滿！

notes.explain: loaf 是一整條、一整個的麵包，複數是 loaves。一整條切片吐司是 a loaf of sliced bread。

example.en: Can I get a loaf of whole wheat bread?
example.zh: 我可以買一條全麥麵包嗎？

notes.explain: 叫不出東西的名字時，用手指著說 one of those / two of those 就能點，店員一看就懂。

example.en: Can I get one of those and two of these?
example.zh: 我要那個一個，這個兩個。

notes.explain: 決定購買時最自然的說法。one 可以代替剛提到的東西，例如 I'll take a small one.。

example.en: I'll take the chocolate one, please.

notes.explain: 英文的 toast 是「烤過的麵包片」。整條沒烤過的吐司叫 bread 或 sliced bread。

example.en: I'll buy a loaf of bread and make toast at home.
example.zh: 我買一條吐司，回家自己烤。

notes.explain: 中文的「都可以」直譯成 I don't care. 會聽起來冷淡又不耐煩。想表達隨和，說 Either one is fine. 比較得體。

example.en: Small or large? Either one is fine, thanks.
example.zh: 小的還是大的？都可以，謝謝。
